mapper.select: SELECT user_no, private_account, feed_visibility, story_visibility, allow_mention, allow_tag FROM ultary_user_privacy WHERE user_no = #{userNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ultary_user_privacy ( user_no, private_account, feed_visibility, story_visibility, allow_mention, allow_tag ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{privateAccount}, #{feedVisibility}, #{storyVisibility}, #{allowMention}, #{allowTag} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE private_account = VALUES(private_account), feed_visibility = VALUES(feed_visibility), story_visibility = VALUES(story_visibility), allow_mention = VALUES(allow_mention), allow_tag = VALUES(allow_tag)
